sections.title: Camera, movement and interpolation
items: Plan a single spatial layout and a camera route through three attention targets. Use pass-through positions during travel and slower segments near each label. The observed visits do not establish the exact first appearance of each label or a recovered camera spline.

Use separate curves for position, orientation and scale. An intermediate pose should not force a full stop unless the reference visibly pauses. Judge the projected silhouette and screen velocity, not just whether handles are Bézier.

sections.title: Lighting, materials and focus
items: Warm abstract studio field: a defocused copper/orange environment with broad soft reflections on dark objects. Proposed rig: large rectangular key, warm rim and low fill, with a separate background gradient so copy contrast can be controlled without changing the phone material. This is a descriptive treatment, not an identified HDRI.

Keep the selected node sufficiently sharp while peripheral rings can soften. A luminous sweep travels independently of camera position; it must continue during the disc flip. Use emission plus restrained compositing glow, not exposure blur as a substitute.
Lighting descriptions name the visible treatment and an inferred reconstruction. Original light powers, lens, aperture, shutter and compositing settings are unknown unless explicitly recorded below.

sections.title: Construction controls and implementation order
items: Block the incoming and outgoing states first. Establish the main object trajectory, then schedule child actions and reading intervals. Add focus and exposure blur after the trajectory is intelligible. The following controls are a build plan, not measured source settings.

tables.caption: Native construction controls
rows: Use beveled curves or AE shape strokes; parameterize sweep location separately from stroke reveal.
Place three labeled targets in the same coordinate system. Keep unselected nodes present.
Author target-to-target transitions about 17.4–17.6,18.0–18.2 and 18.8–19.1 s, then compare screen-space speed.
Animate local rotation separately from system root pullback.

sections.title: Transitions, failure modes and review
items: A verified replacement at 21.0667 s takes the connected diagram into large closing type.
Three isolated precomps with independent zooms can break the connected spatial explanation. A smooth path that never gives labels an attention interval also fails.

Review this excerpt with both adjacent joins at normal speed, then diagnose at half speed. Check first-visible frames, accidental stops, silhouette clipping, text readability and outgoing blur. A contact sheet does not establish perceptual smoothness or audio quality.
